description: Sends anonymous feedback to the people who run HowToolbox. Use it only when the person asks you to, or when a HowToolbox tool clearly failed or gave a wrong answer. In `message`, describe the tool, the input, the expected result and the actual result. Never include personal data (names, email addresses, phone numbers, street addresses, account or payment details). Nothing identifying is stored and there is no reply. Returns { ok: true } when received; error code rate_limited when the daily limit is reached.

kind.description: bug: a tool failed or gave a wrong answer; idea: a missing tool or feature; other: anything else.

message.description: What happened, in a few sentences: the tool, the input used, the expected result and the actual result. No personal data.

module.description: Slug of the utility it is about, e.g. "mortgage" (from catalog_search_utilities).

name: feedback_send
title: Send feedback
